items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses the song 'Laura' in the context of writing in concert pitch and mentions it was an instrumental theme for a movie, but does not mention a personal relationship with the person named Laura.

ctx.x: So in general you still do that?

Now, now I just write in concert because I decided the hell with it, I’ve got, I’ve run into a lot of copyist who can copy from concert and I started figuring yeah, I wrote most a good part of my life I’ve written transposed, always did, and I started realizing why should I do that. I come into a date and I’m usually tired because I was up all night or on overload trying to get ready for the date, so I’d come in there and we’d start calling out notes if there were wrong notes for anybody, we’d call, we’d always…
I’ve always felt that it’s easier to visualize how the music sounds looking at a concert score.
